# GeoBasket
> GeoBasket is a Russian geospatial software and services site focused on GIS tools, mapping, spatial data processing, and related solutions.

GeoBasket presents geospatial products, implementation services, and technical materials around GIS, cartography, remote sensing, and spatial analytics for professional users and organizations.

## Main
- [Home](https://geobasket.ru/): Main entry point for GeoBasket products, services, and geospatial solutions.
- [About](https://geobasket.ru/about/): Overview of the company, expertise, and geospatial specialization.
- [Contacts](https://geobasket.ru/contacts/): Contact information for sales, support, and partnership inquiries.
- [News](https://geobasket.ru/news/): Updates, announcements, and recent activity from the GeoBasket team.

## Products
- [Products](https://geobasket.ru/products/): Catalog of GIS software, mapping tools, and geospatial product offerings.
- [GIS Software](https://geobasket.ru/products/gis/): GIS-oriented software solutions for spatial analysis and mapping workflows.
- [Remote Sensing](https://geobasket.ru/products/remote-sensing/): Tools and solutions for imagery processing and earth observation tasks.
- [Cartography](https://geobasket.ru/products/cartography/): Products for map production, visualization, and cartographic workflows.
- [Spatial Data](https://geobasket.ru/products/spatial-data/): Solutions related to spatial datasets, storage, and geodata handling.

## Services
- [Services](https://geobasket.ru/services/): Overview of implementation, consulting, and support services.
- [Consulting](https://geobasket.ru/services/consulting/): GIS and geospatial consulting for project planning and solution design.
- [Implementation](https://geobasket.ru/services/implementation/): Deployment and integration services for geospatial systems.
- [Technical Support](https://geobasket.ru/services/support/): Ongoing support and maintenance for deployed GIS solutions.
- [Training](https://geobasket.ru/services/training/): Educational and onboarding services for geospatial software users.

## Solutions
- [Solutions](https://geobasket.ru/solutions/): Industry and use-case oriented geospatial solution overview.
- [Urban Planning](https://geobasket.ru/solutions/urban-planning/): Spatial tools and workflows for planning and territorial development.
- [Environmental Monitoring](https://geobasket.ru/solutions/environmental-monitoring/): Geospatial approaches for ecological analysis and monitoring.
- [Infrastructure](https://geobasket.ru/solutions/infrastructure/): GIS solutions for infrastructure inventory, planning, and operations.
- [Agriculture](https://geobasket.ru/solutions/agriculture/): Spatial analysis and mapping applications for agricultural use cases.
